facts.fact: The draft national AI strategy says the Kenya Bureau of Standards released a Draft AI Code of Practice on 8 April 2024 to uphold citizens' rights in developing AI systems.
facts.system: Draft Information Technology Artificial Intelligence Code of Practice

facts.fact: The draft strategy says the Kenya Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Society Bill 2023 to regulate AI use is still in draft and lacks meaningful support.
facts.system: Kenya Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Society Bill 2023

facts.fact: The draft strategy's assessment says the Data Protection Act (2019) regulates automated decision-making; it also says Kenya has no specific AI law.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy

claims.gtmi-c22c10d9cf: nothing: ethics guidelines are not a rule on AI harms; the strategy calls for ethical guidelines and states no institutionalized ones
